title: Looking for Spring
synopsis: Have you seen springtime in different parts of China?

fullText.simplified:
找春天

    我们都知道中国很大，但是你知道，中国最美的春天在哪里吗？这个问题，很难回答。打开地图，你会发现，中国最南边离最北边很远。一样的时间，每个地方的季节都不一样。
    从二月开始，中国南方就是春天了。可以去看花，每个城市都有自己的花。这个季节总是不停地下雨，有的人觉得很可爱，有的人觉得不习惯。
    到了三月，可以去北方找春天。北方人常说，春天的天气，像孩子的脸，意思是天气变化很快。这个季节花开了，草绿了，鸟从南方回来了。周末可以去爬山，因为这个季节，不冷也不热，天很蓝，云很白。
    四月的时候可以去中国最北边。这里冬天刚结束，是最晚的春天。河里开始有河水，树也绿了。
    去了很多地方，可能还是找不到答案，因为每个地方都不一样。但是有一个地方的春天你一定喜欢，那就是老家的春天。因为最美的地方，总是在老家，在心里。
fullText.traditional:
找春天

    我們都知道中國很大，但是你知道，中國最美的春天在哪裏嗎？這個問題，很難回答。打開地圖，你會發現，中國最南邊離最北邊很遠。一樣的時間，每個地方的季節都不一樣。
    從二月開始，中國南方就是春天了。可以去看花，每個城市都有自己的花。這個季節總是不停地下雨，有的人覺得很可愛，有的人覺得不習慣。
    到了三月，可以去北方找春天。北方人常說，春天的天氣，像孩子的臉，意思是天氣變化很快。這個季節花開了，草綠了，鳥從南方回來了。週末可以去爬山，因為這個季節，不冷也不熱，天很藍，雲很白。
    四月的時候可以去中國最北邊。這裡冬天剛結束，是最晚的春天。河裡開始有河水，樹也綠了。
    去了很多地方，可能還是找不到答案，因為每個地方都不一樣。但是有一個地方的春天你一定喜歡，那就是老家的春天。因為最美的地方，總是在老家，在心裡。

sentences.traditional: 打開地圖，你會發現，中國最南邊離最北邊很遠。

sentences.english: This question is very difficult to answer.

sentences.simplified: 一样的时间，每个地方的季节都不一样。
sentences.traditional: 一樣的時間，每個地方的季節都不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: yí yàng de shí jiān měi ge dì fang de jì jié dōu bù yí yàng
sentences.english: Open a map, and you will discover that the southernmost part of China is very far from the northernmost part.
At the same point in time, every place is in a different season.

sentences.traditional: 這個季節總是不停地下雨，有的人覺得很可愛，有的人覺得不習慣。

sentences.english: Starting from February, it is springtime in southern China. You can go look at flowers. Every city has it’s own flower.
In this season it always rains incessantly. Some people think it’s very cute, while others think it doesn’t agree with them.

sentences.traditional: 到了三月，可以去北方找春天。

sentences.traditional: 北方人常說，春天的天氣，像孩子的臉，意思是天氣變化很快。

sentences.english: When March has arrived, you can go to the north to look for spring.

sentences.traditional: 這個季節花開了，草綠了，鳥從南方回來了。

sentences.english: Northerners often say that spring weather is like the face of a child, meaning that the weather changes very fast.

sentences.pinyin: zhōu mò kě yǐ qù pá shān
sentences.english: In this season the flowers bloom, the grass turns green, and the birds return from the south.

Because in this season, it’s not cold and also not hot, the sky is very blue, and the clouds are very white.

sentences.traditional: 河裡開始有河水，樹也綠了。

sentences.english: In April you can go to the northernmost part of China. Winter has just finished here. This is the latest spring.

sentences.english: After going to many places, it’s still possible that you haven’t found an answer, because every place is different.

sentences.simplified: 因为最美的地方，总是在老家，在心里。

Because the most beautiful place in your heart is always your hometown.

raw.synopsis: Have you seen springtime in different parts of China?
sentence_translations: We all know that China is very big, but do you know where in China the spring is the most beautiful?
This question is very difficult to answer.
Open a map, and you will discover that the southernmost part of China is very far from the northernmost part.
At the same point in time, every place is in a different season.
Starting from February, it is springtime in southern China. You can go look at flowers. Every city has it’s own flower.
In this season it always rains incessantly. Some people think it’s very cute, while others think it doesn’t agree with them.
When March has arrived, you can go to the north to look for spring.
Northerners often say that spring weather is like the face of a child, meaning that the weather changes very fast.
In this season the flowers bloom, the grass turns green, and the birds return from the south.
On weekends you can go hiking in the mountains.
Because in this season, it’s not cold and also not hot, the sky is very blue, and the clouds are very white.
In April you can go to the northernmost part of China. Winter has just finished here. This is the latest spring.
The rivers start to have water and the trees also turn green.
After going to many places, it’s still possible that you haven’t found an answer, because every place is different.
But there is one place where you will certainly like the spring, and that’s the spring in your hometown.
Because the most beautiful place in your heart is always your hometown.
